environment.description: Flask application deployed on Ubuntu 22.04 bare-metal server with default AppArmor profile (unconfined mode). Application runs as www-data user with write access to /var/lib/myapp/ and standard filesystem permissions. No CSRF protection middleware. Session cookies set without SameSite attribute (defaults to None in older Flask). Nginx reverse proxy with default configuration, no additional security headers injected.

config.apparmor_status: unconfined (complain mode, no enforced profile for python3)
